text:
carol: quick thought — can we add a tiny, optional "warmup-hint" header to safetensors/shard metadata to steer eager vs lazy hydration? mostly for cold-start QoS on Dedicated clusters.
sam: short answer: yes, but need to define semantics. what fields are you thinking? priority vs min_prefetch?
carol: something minimal: {
  "warmup_hint": "priority_hint",
  "priority_hint": "hot|warm|cold",
  "min_prefetch_bytes": 0,
  "kv_anchor": false
}
should be advisory only — runtime can override.
lee: advisory-only is good. main tradeoff: more metadata on every shard increases manifest size and tooling complexity. also remote manifests + gzipped transport might bloat.
mika: also think about multi-format: some customers use tarball bundles with legacy index. do we want a cross-format shim (manifest field) or embed in format-specific headers?
carol: preference: format-agnostic manifest field named `x.warmup_hint` and then optional format-specific header for safetensors/tar. keeps runtime lookup uniform.
lee: runtime cost: lookup path should be O(1) per-shard without reading entire payload. we should put header in index/sidecar so we don't need to mmap whole file.
sam: +1 for index/sidecar. for safetensors we can reuse the existing `.index` sidecar or the per-shard compact header we already parse on open. avoid forcing mmap to read header.
carol: perf goals: when priority_hint=hot, runtime should try to prefetch whole shard into GPU memory during warmup windows; warm = prefetch small leading chunk (KV + first N MB), cold = lazy stream. also an optional `min_prefetch_bytes` helps on very wide embeddings layers.
mika: sounds reasonable. can we add `eviction_tolerance` numeric (0..1) so scheduler knows how aggressive to be when under memory pressure? small files could be hot even if low hint.
lee: eviction_tolerance feels like policy, probably better as playlist-level QoS override in runtime config, not per-checkpoint. otherwise ops will have to patch checkpoints.
carol: fair. keep shard header tiny: priority_hint + min_prefetch_bytes + optional `hot_window_ms` (how long to try to finish prefetch).
ops-bot: deploy note: adding sidecar schema field will need manifest version bump. created ticket: INF-2345.
sam: compatibility note: runtime must treat missing hint as `warm` default for backward compatibility, and not break manifestless fallbacks.
mika: telemetry: add counters for when hint != chosen_policy and reason (missing capacity, policy override, backlog). helps validate hint usefulness.
lee: follow-up: I'll draft the index schema diff and a tiny loader patch that reads `x.warmup_hint` from index JSON and exposes it through WeightSource API as metadata.
carol: thanks. can we also unit-test that hot hint triggers full prefetch in our CI on a small model? cheap integration test to catch regressions.
sam: will add to runtime-smoke.
carol: ok cool — I'll file the RFC follow-up with example header and rollout plan (no default enforcement in prod until we collect telemetry). :thumbsup:
